repair.problem: Temporary deployment propagation and upstream recovery states can surface as red failures and enter the repair loop.
repair.root_cause: Failure triage previously treated every non-success/non-skipped lane as a repairable failure even when evidence proved the system was only waiting on an external state transition.
repair.patch: Add an evidence-backed WAIT state machine ahead of repair ownership. WAIT states leave the failure/repair queue, forbid blind retries, and allow recheck only after a meaningful state-token change.
